s.title: Settings
s.lang.p: Freeboard follows your Mac’s language. Pick one here to use a different one.
s.warn.p: Dinghy gets worried in the amber zone and panics in the red one.
s.scan.p: Freeboard looks for projects, worktrees and caches here.
s.empty1: No folders yet. Add one, or Freeboard only checks tool caches.
s.lock.p: Freeboard never removes these, whatever you choose.
s.last: Last scan {t}. Quick scans run every hour.
s.quick.s: Known caches and tools, about 10 seconds
s.deep.s: Every file in your folders, about a minute
ob.balanced.n: Room for a big build or a model pull.
ob.roomy.n: Early warnings. For heavy Docker or AI work.
ob.b0: Hi, I’m Dinghy. I keep your disk above the waterline.
ob.b1.crit: With {f} free I’d already be under. Let’s fix that first.
ob.b1.warn: With {f} free I’m riding low. I’ll nudge you.
ob.b2: Let me look around. Where do you keep your code?
ob.b3: Here’s my promise. Read it, then we’re off.
ob.b4.done: Found {x} I could toss. Nothing moved yet.
ob.h0: Know before your disk is full.
ob.p0: Freeboard watches your free space, finds what you can safely remove, and asks before anything goes. Setup takes about a minute.
ob.pr1.s: Before a build fails on a full disk.
ob.pr2.s: Caches and builds first. The rest, only if you say yes.
ob.pr3.s: Nothing about your files leaves this computer.
ob.p1: I warn you when free space drops under Low, and get loud under Critical. You can change this anytime in Settings.
ob.h2: Where do you keep your code?
ob.p2: I found these. I’ll look for worktrees, node_modules and build output inside them. Sizes and dates only, never file contents.
ob.h3: What I read, and what I never do.
ob.r1: Free space on your disk, every 5 minutes
ob.r2: Reports from Docker, Git, pnpm, pip and friends
ob.r3: Sizes and dates in the folders you chose
ob.n1: Remove anything without a plan you confirm
ob.sw1: Show free space in the menu bar
ob.sw2.s: So the warnings actually reach you.
ob.fda.s: macOS hides these until you allow Full Disk Access. Optional.
ob.nothing: Nothing is removed until you confirm.
nt.safe: {f} left. {s} can be freed from Safe items.
nt.none: {f} left. Open Freeboard to see what you can remove.
s.deep.s2: Every file in your folders and the disk map, a few minutes
s.q.daily: Quick scans run once a day.
s.q.ask: Quick scans run when you ask.
s.size.later: Size known after a deep scan
ob.sw1.tray: Show free space next to the tray icon
ob.tidy: to toss right now. Your disk is tidy.
risk.safe.l: Freeboard can show this rebuilds or downloads again on its own. Nothing of yours is lost.
risk.review.l: Nothing is lost for good, but getting it back costs you something: a download, a rebuild, or a trip to the Trash. Worth a glance.
risk.risky.l: Freeboard can’t prove this is safe to remove, and removing it can’t be undone. It may be the only copy of something you need.
ack.lost: I understand this cannot be recovered.
q.none: You have no questions left. Your answers are in the crate pile above.
r.changed: It changed after the scan. Scan again to remove it.
p.why: They may hold work that exists only here, such as uncommitted or unpushed changes. Commit and push them, and I can clean them next time.
e.title: Everything I found
e.sum1: 1 item, {x} in total. Tick to add to the pile. Open a row for details.
e.sumN: {n} items, {x} in total. Tick to add to the pile. Open a row for details.
e.none: Nothing yet. Run a scan from Settings, or wait for the next one.
c.notstarted: Not started, the cleanup was stopped
cs.docker: Docker Desktop can take a while to hand space back. The Logbook shows the measured change.
cs.safe: Each item is checked again just before it goes. Anything that changed since the scan stays put.
cs.hint: Tick the box on each item that cannot be recovered, or leave it out and toss the rest.
cs.intrash: {x} is in the {t}. It frees up when you empty it.
cs.expected: I expected to free {x}. This is the change your disk reports.
cs.s.stayed.s: They changed after the scan, so I left them alone
cs.s.notstarted.s: You stopped the run before these
cs.empty.p: Only the items I moved there are deleted. Everything else in your {t} stays where it is.
cs.empty.title: Empty {x} from the {t}?
cs.t.error: I can't do that right now
lg.docker: Docker Desktop may take a while to return its space, so the measured change can be lower than expected.
lg.expected: I expected to free {x}. This is the change your disk reported.
lg.title: Logbook
lg.none: No cleanups yet. Each cleanup you confirm is recorded here.
m.account: I can account for {a} of the {b} {u} in use.
m.incomplete: These areas add up to {x} more than the disk says is in use, so this map is incomplete.
m.twice.mac: APFS clones and snapshots can be counted twice.
m.twice: Some files may be counted twice.
m.nodeep: I measure folders during a deep scan. Until one runs, most of this space is not explained.
m.purge: macOS can free {x} of purgeable space on its own. Finder counts it as free, so its totals differ from these.
m.snap1: macOS keeps 1 local snapshot of this disk.
m.snapN: macOS keeps {n} local snapshots of this disk.
m.skip.t: Count it as yours and stop asking
m.allclear.p: Every GB in use now belongs to a named area.
m.lede: None of it is lost. I just can’t see inside it yet.
m.lede.fix: The parts with a button below have a fix.
m.lede.all: None of it is lost. I just can’t see inside it yet. Each part below has a fix.
m.foot.closer: Fixing them brings the map closer to 100%.
m.foot: Nothing here is removed, it only gets measured.
m.foot.all: Fix them all and the map reaches 100%. Nothing here is removed, it only gets measured.
m.grow.none: I need a few days of scans to see what is growing.
pl.title: {n} places I checked
pl.tap: Tap one to open it on the map.
pl.off.p: {list}. The tool did not answer; I will try again on the next scan.
pl.fixit: Fix it in “Why it isn’t explained”
so.title: Second opinion
so.p: Copy sizes and folder names for your AI agent. No file contents.
so.copied: Copied. Paste it into your agent.
a.dinghy: Dinghy the boat. It sits lower in the water as the disk fills.
h.noservice: Freeboard could not reach its background service. {e}
nat.old.p: A newer version of Freeboard has used this computer, and this older copy can't read its data. Install the latest Freeboard from the website.
